info.title: API.SH: mobile.de
info.description: The mobile.de API from API.SH: public mobile.de data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A mobile.de dealer: name, address, coordinates, email, phone, languages, rating, years on mobile.de, VAT id, imprint, logo, website and their cars for sale (same fields as /mobilede/v1/search), with the total count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

get.description:
Every car make on mobile.de with its id, for the make parameter of /mobilede/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mobilede-makes

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search cars for sale on mobile.de (Germany) with the site's filters: make and model, price, first registration year, mileage, power, seats, engine size, cylinders, battery capacity and electric range (min/max pairs), fuel, gearbox, body type, exterior and interior colour, upholstery, condition, seller type, drive type, doors, emission class and sticker, climate control, cruise control, tow bar, previous owners, inspection validity, availability, damaged cars, price rating, registration type, parking aids, headlights, equipment features, listing options (photos, video, price reduced), days online, location and radius, country, VAT reclaimable, seller id and keyword. Each listing has its id, link, title, subtitle, make, model, body type, price, price rating, first registration, mileage, power, fuel, gearbox, engine size, colour, doors, seats, emission class, previous owners, inspection date, consumption, location, seller (id, name, type, rating, phones), leasing and finance offers, highlights and image, plus `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (the site shows at most 50 pages).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mobilede-search

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Make name (Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen) or its id from /mobilede/v1/makes.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model name (A4, 3er Reihe, Golf) or the site's model id. Needs make. Responses list the make's models.

parameters.name: min_year
parameters.description: First registered in or after this year.

parameters.name: max_year
parameters.description: First registered in or before this year.

parameters.name: fuel
parameters.description: Comma separated: PETROL, DIESEL, ELECTRICITY, HYBRID, HYBRID_DIESEL, ETHANOL, HYDROGENIUM, LPG, CNG, OTHER.

parameters.name: body_type
parameters.description: Comma separated: Cabrio, OffRoad, SmallCar, EstateCar, Limousine, SportsCar, Van, OtherCar.

parameters.name: exterior_color
parameters.description: Comma separated: BEIGE, BLUE, BROWN, YELLOW, GOLD, GREEN, GREY, ORANGE, RED, BLACK, SILVER, PURPLE, WHITE.

parameters.name: interior_color
parameters.description: Comma separated: BEIGE, BLACK, BLUE, BROWN, GREY, RED, OTHER_INTERIOR_COLOR.

parameters.name: interior_type
parameters.description: Comma separated: ALCANTARA, FABRIC, IMITATION_LEATHER, PARTIAL_LEATHER, LEATHER, VELOUR, OTHER_INTERIOR_TYPE.

parameters.name: seller_type
parameters.description: Dealer, private seller or commercial private seller.

parameters.name: previous_owners_max
parameters.description: At most this many previous owners.

parameters.name: inspection_months
parameters.description: Roadworthiness inspection (HU) valid for at least this many months.

parameters.name: damaged
parameters.description: Damaged cars: false leaves them out, true shows only them.

parameters.name: registration_type
parameters.description: Comma separated: CLASSIC, DEMONSTRATION, EMPLOYEES_CAR, PRE_REGISTRATION.

parameters.name: parking_assistant
parameters.description: Comma separated: CAM_360_DEGREES, REAR_VIEW_CAM, REAR_SENSORS, FRONT_SENSORS, AUTOMATIC_PARKING.

parameters.name: headlights
parameters.description: Comma separated: XENON_HEADLIGHTS, BI_XENON_HEADLIGHTS, LED_HEADLIGHTS, LASER_HEADLIGHTS.

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Equipment, comma separated feature codes: NAVIGATION_SYSTEM, HEAD_UP_DISPLAY, CARPLAY, ANDROID_AUTO, ELECTRIC_HEATED_SEATS, PANORAMIC_GLASS_ROOF, WARRANTY, FULL_SERVICE_HISTORY, NONSMOKER_VEHICLE, ALLOY_WHEELS and the other codes the site uses.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Search around this point (with longitude and radius).

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Search around this point (with latitude and radius).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Car location country (2-letter code, e.g. DE).

parameters.name: seller_id
parameters.description: Only this seller's cars (the dealer id).

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Words to find in the listing description.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A suchen.mobile.de/fahrzeuge/search.html link instead of the filters above.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
